name: Undead Mastery (Item Mastery)
body:
You can extract necromantic power from magic items to force undead to obey you.

Prerequisite(s): Use Magic Device 2 ranks, base Fortitude save bonus +4.

Benefit(s): You can cause an item that has a necromancy spell of 2nd level or higher in its construction requirements to cast command undead.

You can use this feat once per day, plus an additional time per day at base Fortitude save bonus +6, +8, +10, and +12.
